title: Floor 2 Script Released on Delta V3
features:
Main Features and Functionalities: 


Auto Complete Levels: Automatically progress through difficult floors without manual effort.

Infinite Health: Stay alive throughout the game, no matter the obstacles.

Unlock Secret Rooms: Gain access to hidden areas that are usually inaccessible.

Speed Boost: Move through levels at increased speed for faster gameplay.

God Mode: Invincible mode that makes you immune to all damage.

Resource Farming: Automatically collect resources and items to improve your chances of success.

⚠️WARNING⚠️: 

Use at your own risk and execute (the script) after leaving the elevator! ⚠️
